event: Web Summit Lisbon 2026--Commerce Summit 分论坛
title_en: Panel on how AI products land across markets at Web Summit Lisbon 2026
title_zh: 在2026里斯本Web Summit Commerce Summit分论坛参加圆桌讨论
summary_en: Chris spoke on a panel hosted by Grace Shao of AI Proem, alongside Angela Yu of StoReel and Young Wang of Acti. He argued that overseas clients look first for trust, and that Western markets can learn from China's competition and work with China.
summary_zh: 彭家荣在里斯本Web Summit的圆桌上发言，主持人是AI Proem创始人Grace Shao，同台的有StoReel联合创始人Angela Yu和Acti创始人Young Wang。他认为海外客户首先看重信任，西方可以学习中国竞争带来的创新，也可以与中国合作、共同变强。
quote_en: If someone likes you, they'll figure out a way to work with you. If they don't like you, they'll make sure you'll never be successful.
quote_zh: 如果有人喜欢你，他们会想办法与你合作；如果他们不喜欢你，就会确保你永远不会成功。
caption: Chris 发言特写（横图）

title_en: Founder mentoring at Web Summit 2026 China EU Forum, Lisbon
title_zh: 在里斯本 Web Summit 2026 China EU Forum 辅导早期创业者
summary_en: Chris mentored early stage founders for about 50 minutes in Lisbon, including teams building AI payment compliance, recruiting, social event and AI visibility tools. He told them technology can all be copied, and only relationships and trust cannot, so brand trust comes first.
summary_zh: 彭家荣在里斯本与早期创业者交流约50分钟，参与项目涉及AI支付智能体合规控制、招聘工具、线下社交应用和AI可见度工具。他认为技术都可以复制，无法复制的是关系和信任，因此要先做品牌信任，再做品牌知名度。
quote_en: Technology can all be copied. The only things that cannot be copied are relationships and trust.
quote_zh: 技术都可以复制，唯一无法复制的是关系和信任。

title_en: Keynote at the PEO ASIA 2026 Annual Business Conference
title_zh: 在PEO ASIA 2026年度商务会议发表主旨演讲
summary_en: Chris spoke on how Chinese companies can build global competitiveness, arguing that product, price and trust must work together and that local trust is the gap to close in the next decade. The audience was Asian entrepreneurs, executives and business leaders in North America.
summary_zh: 彭家荣在会上谈中国企业如何从成本优势走向全球竞争力，提出产品、价格、信任构成铁三角，未来十年需要补上的是在本地建立信任。听众是北美的亚洲企业家、高管与商业领袖。
quote_en: The most effective way to grow business is actually the oldest way, which is making friends offline.
quote_zh: 最有效果的业务拓展方式，其实是最古老的一个方式，就是线下交朋友。

event: 一财全球十周年生态大会暨新十年战略发布
title_en: Panel at Yicai Global's 10th Anniversary Ecosystem Conference, Shanghai
title_zh: 在一财全球十周年生态大会暨新十年战略发布（上海）参加圆桌讨论
summary_en: Chris joined a Yicai panel in Shanghai with Jiang Yan, Chen Shuihai of BIPO and Lu Yao of the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences. He said talk of a global retreat is inaccurate, since Chinese firms going abroad mark a new generation of globalisation.
summary_zh: 彭家荣在上海参加第一财经圆桌讨论，与云隙咨询的蒋燕、BIPO的陈水海、上海社科院的卢尧同台。他认为“全球化退潮”的说法并不准确，中国企业出海是新一代全球化的特征。
quote_en: When Chinese companies go out into the world one by one, what stands behind them is further globalisation.
quote_zh: 一个个出海企业走向世界的时候，背后是进一步的全球化。
